params.sigma_source: approach3 5-year calibration of IF futures close
params.rate_convention: SHIBOR zero from approach3: log(1 + quoted*365/360*tau)/tau, linear in tau
params.cvar_definition: mean of the largest ceil((1-level)*n) losses; losses are -V_T

pnl_definitions.brief: sum_t exp(r*(T-t*dt)) D_t (S_{t+1}-S_t) - kappa sum_t |D_t-D_{t-1}| S_t - payoff, D_{-1}=0, no terminal unwind
pnl_definitions.selffin: sum_t exp(r*(T-(t+1)*dt)) D_t (S_{t+1}-exp(r*dt) S_t) - kappa sum_t exp(r*(T-t*dt)) |D_t-D_{t-1}| S_t - payoff, D_{-1}=0, no terminal unwind

params.turnover_definition: mean over paths of sum_t |D_t-D_{t-1}| S_t / S0
params.limitation: The policy sees only (S_t/S0, t/T), not the previous position, so it cannot represent a no-trade region. This is a structural limitation of the specified input set.

deep_kappa0_vs_bs_daily.note: If a ratio is clearly above one, this is treated as a training failure, not as evidence about the method.
